scope: Fresh full API + engines + integration regression after Attio visual integration

warning_details.message: Using `httpx` with `starlette.testclient` is deprecated; install `httpx2` instead.
warning_details.effect: No failing assertions; existing test transport deprecation.

database_isolation.ordinary_fixtures: Separate in-memory SQLite engines and get_db dependency overrides; platform/worker SessionLocal overridden by fixture sessions where used.
database_isolation.global_engine_safety: DATABASE_URL=sqlite:// only within the pytest process prevents a fallback engine from referencing a product DB.
database_isolation.postgres_fixture: test_postgres_concurrency.py creates a random vector_backend_audit_<uuid12> database; schema resets and DROP DATABASE target only this exact fixture DB.

limitations: This is a backend/engine integration regression, not browser verification or a video fidelity check.
Synthetic fixtures and authored engine evaluation do not measure human validity, hiring success or real participant calibration.
Official FSP registry synchronization was not exercised; demo registry provenance is tested separately from real registry claims.
OIDC uses signed test-provider protocol fixtures; commercial ATS and real external identity-provider load were not tested.
Untrusted user code remains fail-closed without the configured isolated runner; actual Linux/gVisor execution was not performed on this Windows host.
Process-selection tests use mock CIM records; no main service restart, stop, or process mutation was performed.
Elapsed test duration is observed on this concurrently active local workstation; it is not an isolated performance benchmark.
